testCase.name: [local] S21 axe on the screens TC-25 touches, on desktop and phone profiles

descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A4 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Text contrast below WCAG AA in several places (survey button 3.66:1, Previous Notes header 2.5:1, dashboard room line)

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-06/S24a, TC-13/S22, TC-20/S18

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S21 axe on the screens TC-25 touches, on desktop and phone profiles

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in. (UAT TC-25 step 1; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 9; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, Pixel 7 and iPhone 15

When Run axe on the sign-in form, both lists, both charts and the chart of a patient deleted from the other device; on an open list, focus a card's control and delete that patient from the other context

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the sign-in fields have labels; after the remote delete keyboard focus is not lost to the page body (WCAG 2.4.3)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violation count = 0 (visual-checks.ts); document.activeElement after the remote delete is recorded as evidence for a person

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

The sign-in screen's Send code button and footer, the patient lists and the charts have low-contrast text, and after a patient is deleted on another device the keyboard focus jumps to the top of the page.

Evidence: allure-results/9f57a3da…: 9 pass / 18 fail. axe contrast fails on the sign-in footer and Send-code button, both lists and both charts. Focus after a remote delete falls to the page body (recorded, WCAG 2.4.3). The deleted-elsewhere chart is axe-clean.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S21

axe on the screens TC-25 touches, on desktop and phone profiles

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: partly): account.spec.ts: sign-in form (signed out, code step stubbed), both lists, both charts, a chart whose patient is deleted through the API while open; axe (all), field labels; focus after a remote delete of the focused card recorded for a person. — The focus outcome (WCAG 2.4.3) is recorded for a person per the oracle; two real devices are TC-25's other scenarios.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 9 judged check(s) passed, 18 failed. Sign-in email and code fields are labelled; the deleted-elsewhere chart shows 'Patient not found.' with Back to rounds (axe clean). Focus after deleting the focused patient on the other device falls to the page body (recorded for a person, WCAG 2.4.3).

Product issue: axe violations on the sign-in screen (footer and Send-code contrast), both lists and both charts (oracle: violation count = 0).

Recorded-only cells (recorded): After the remote deletes no alert or banner is shown on the list (recorded 'alerts shown on the list after the remote deletes: []' on all three profiles). A red 'Chart access couldn’t be recorded. Check your connection and reload.' banner was seen once, in OAT-03/S22 desktop nh-scan-error (pre-review run, nothing deleted), while the shared local backend was under other jobs' load: not tied to a delete, unconfirmed (convex/access.ts logChartAccess returns null without an error for a missing row). vision-review (for a person): the deleted-elsewhere chart says only 'Patient not found.'

Evidence: 10 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-25_S21 — a folder (51 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key) and make-session.ts refuses dev; the 'deleted elsewhere' screen also needs a second context.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
